title: vectorStandardNamespaceSchemaV1
description: A single vector standard namespace - one source database and the layer source describing it. Namespaces are consumed as an array, and the config package stops descending at arrays, so no x-env-value declared or inherited below this point is ever bound. Per namespace values, credentials in particular, are expected to come from referenced config instances.

name.description: The namespace identifier. Appears in the destination database primary keys, in the API path and as a key in the aliases file, so it is restricted to URL safe characters

db.description: The source database for this namespace. A config instance of https://mapcolonies.com/common/db/full/v3 can be referenced here directly

layersFile.description: The path to this namespace's layers file. Each namespace owns its own file - sharing one across namespaces is always a mistake

bucket.description: The S3 bucket holding this namespace's layer source. The connection itself is shared and configured once under dbs.s3

layerSource.description: Where layer identity and property aliases come from. The two modes are mutually exclusive: sharedLua requires the lua fields and carries the enrichment API, perLayerJson forbids enrichment outright, because without a layer id its url template cannot be resolved. The exclusivity is enforced by shape rather than by a runtime check

type.description: Which layer source this namespace uses

fileName.description: sharedLua only. The key of the lua file within the bucket

layersVariable.description: sharedLua only. Lua layers variable name

aliasFieldName.description: sharedLua only. Lua alias field name

idFieldName.description: sharedLua only. Lua id field name

nameFieldName.description: sharedLua only. Lua name field name

prefix.description: perLayerJson only. Optional key prefix within the bucket, prepended to the file name configured for each layer

aliasLayerNameField.description: perLayerJson only. The field holding the layer alias

fieldsField.description: perLayerJson only. The field holding the array of field definitions

fieldNameField.description: perLayerJson only. The field within a field definition holding the source column name. Matched against the database columns case insensitively

aliasFieldNameField.description: perLayerJson only. The field within a field definition holding the property alias

enrichment.description: sharedLua only. Property alias enrichment over http

api.description: Property alias name API. Supports the {layerName} and {layerId} placeholders

requestTimeoutMilliseconds.description: Timeout for enrichment API requests in milliseconds
